name: Textarea
description: SEED contract for the Phase-1 reader round (docs/35 §3) — antd's multiline control is the COMPOUND export `Input.TextArea` (antd/es/input/TextArea.js wrapping rc-textarea; there is no top-level TextArea export), mounted through the compound-export-name grammar (importRoot `Input`, member path `.TextArea`). The `content` axis is the recipe's empty|value column expanded by the config through $props into the controlled `value` string. HTML `rows` default 2 (WHATWG; the antd wrapper sets none) — deliberately NOT pinned so the capture records the library's own default rendering. Subject: antd@5.29.3 (pinned, examples/antd/PROVENANCE.md).
